answer: Admission auction: 40 slots open per epoch on a price terrace; winners lock their bid as a bond. The delta between the lowest winning and highest losing bid sets the next reserve. An attacker wanting 20 fakes must win 20 auctions at 2,000 POA, locking 40,000 POA, while one fake earns under 500 POA a month. Each slot is an island of collateral, one bond per slot. An honest agent pays once, is refunded after 20 epochs, and keeps rewards undiluted.
